KEYCLOAK-8133,Can't Sucessfully inject a custom KeycloakSpringBootConfigResolver in the Keycloak Spring Boot Security Adapter,"We need to support multi-tenancy on our Spring boot resource server. The instructions described [here|https://www.keycloak.org/docs/latest/securing_apps/index.html#_multi_tenancy] are problematic in that it requires a web.xml change. Using Spring boot 2 with embedded tomcat, there is no web.xml file which can be modified. All attempts to add an init or context param programmatically though java were unsuccessful.
An attempt to accomplish this which is different from the official documentation also failed. Described below:
public class MultiTenantBearerTokenConfigResolver extends KeycloakSpringBootConfigResolver implements KeycloakConfigResolver {
The code above works if injected as a bean:

This will successfully inject the bean. The problem is that the Security Adapter also creates an instance of KeycloakSpringBootConfigResolver since we were unable to modify the web.xml. Now both ConfigResolvers (custom and default)  will execute per request instead of only the desired custom ConfigResolver.
Cannot override and create a custom KeycloakSpringBootConfigResolver on Spring Boot 2 with Embedded Tomcat.
